note: Story Q2 Results Today Live: Infosys, Adani Power, JSW Steel, Tata Motors…: JK Tyre & Industries reported a 71.3% decline in consolidated Q2 profit to ₹65.11 crore and 20.7% revenue growth. Story Tata Motors pips Mahindra to be No. 2 car company in April-September: Mahindra dispatched just under 3.6 lakh passenger vehicles, growing around 20%, while India's passenger-vehicle market grew 28.3% to around 26.4 lakh units during April–September FY27. Both are independent competitor and market facts.
